nom: Landing International Purcell 24/7 Colostrum Pore Defence Ampoule

extraits.titre: Returned - Bad atomizer and didn't notice difference
extraits.texte: Not my favorite but not bad either? My biggest beef with it was the atomizer. The spray was thicker droplets and looked and felt kinda spotty on my skin. I will give it some pros though: fragrance free, convenient to travel with or carry around, hydrating for sure. There are better sprays that have done more for me recently.

extraits.titre: Absolute glass skin in a spray
extraits.texte: A new top 10 product for me. My skin looks absolutely incredible using this as my last step before sunscreen, and using it to refresh throughout the day. It also suggests it will cool down hot skin, which I can't wait to test out this summer. Worth every penny.

I bought this on a whim because it was on sale and i was desperate to find something that helps with makeup setting into pores around the t zone. Im seruously so impressed with this product as my pores look noticeably smaller and my skin is smoother. This is now in my top 10 for skin care/makeup products.
Love how its travel size and easy to use. I use this in my skin care and to make sure my makeup stays dewy.
instant glass skin mist!! Looks really really pretty under and over makeup :) < 3
